req_spec.title: UC-S4-001 Course Sharing & Permissions
req_spec.scope: Course owner shares a course with other students as VIEWER or CONTRIBUTOR. Source: UniShare_Iteration_4.md Use Case Diagram 1 + Use Case 1; src/server/api/routers/course.ts (inviteCollaborator, acceptInvitation, rejectInvitation, getPendingInvitations); resource.ts.

requirement.title: Only the course owner can invite collaborators
requirement.description: The system shall allow only the student who created a course to invite collaborators. Any other user shall receive 'Only the owner can invite collaborators'. Inviting to a non-existent course shall return 'Course not found'.

requirement.title: Invalid invitations are rejected
requirement.description: The system shall reject an invitation to the owner himself ('You can't invite yourself') and a second invitation to a user already invited to the same course ('User already invited').

requirement.title: Invitation carries a permission level
requirement.description: The owner shall choose exactly one permission level, VIEWER or CONTRIBUTOR. A new invitation is stored with status PENDING and the invitee receives a COURSE_INVITATION notification '<owner> invited you to collaborate on <course>'.

requirement.title: Invitee accepts or declines a pending invitation
requirement.description: The invitee shall see pending invitations under Settings > Pending Invitations and can Accept or Decline. Accept sets status ACCEPTED and joinedAt and the course appears in the invitee's course list; Decline sets REJECTED. The owner receives 'Invitation accepted' / 'Invitation declined'. Only PENDING invitations can be answered.

requirement.title: VIEWER has read-only access
requirement.description: A VIEWER collaborator can open the shared course, view all resource cards and download files but cannot add, edit or delete resources or upload files.

requirement.title: CONTRIBUTOR can add but not delete
requirement.description: A CONTRIBUTOR can add/update resources and upload files to cards that allow uploads, but cannot delete resources ('Only the course owner can delete resources') or delete the course.

requirement.title: Owner manages collaborators
requirement.description: On Courses > <course> > Collaborators the owner can invite by email, change a collaborator's permission (VIEWER <-> CONTRIBUTOR) and remove a collaborator.

requirement.title: Faculty-restricted sharing
requirement.description: The system shall validate that the invited student belongs to the same faculty as the owner (Iteration 4: 'System validates student is in same faculty').

req_spec.title: UC-S4-003 Public Articles
req_spec.scope: Students write articles that move DRAFT -> PUBLISHED -> ARCHIVED and are readable publicly. Source: UniShare_Iteration_4.md Use Case Diagram 3 + Use Case 3; src/server/api/routers/article.ts; src/app/(student)/my-articles, src/app/articles.

requirement.title: Article input validation
requirement.description: Title is mandatory, 1 to 200 characters; Excerpt optional, max 500 characters; Cover image optional and must be a valid URL; Tags optional, comma-separated. Empty title shows 'Please enter a title for your article'.

requirement.title: New article starts as DRAFT
requirement.description: Saving a new article stores it with status DRAFT, the author as current user, an estimated read time (words/200, rounded up) and shows 'Article saved as draft'.

requirement.title: Unique URL slug
requirement.description: The slug is generated from the title (lower-case, punctuation removed, spaces -> '-'). If the slug exists the system appends -1, -2, ... On title change the slug is regenerated.

requirement.title: Publish workflow
requirement.description: Only the author can publish, and only a DRAFT article can be published ('Only draft articles can be published'). Publishing sets PUBLISHED and publishedAt and shows 'Article published!'.

requirement.title: Archive and delete own article
requirement.description: Only the author can archive ('Article archived') or delete ('Article deleted successfully') an article; other users get 'You can only archive/delete your own articles'.

requirement.title: Edit own article
requirement.description: Only the author can edit an article ('You can only edit your own articles'). Saving shows 'Changes saved'. Tags supplied on edit replace the previous tags.

requirement.title: Public article listing
requirement.description: The /articles page lists only PUBLISHED articles, newest publishedAt first, 12 per page by default (page size 1-50). Search matches title or excerpt case-insensitively; filter by tag; the tag list shows only tags having at least one published article.

requirement.title: Article access control
requirement.description: A PUBLISHED article is readable by anyone, including visitors not logged in. DRAFT and ARCHIVED articles are readable only by the author; others get 'This article is not published'. Unknown slug gives 'Article not found'.

requirement.title: View counter
requirement.description: Opening a PUBLISHED article increments its view count by 1; DRAFT/ARCHIVED articles are not counted.

requirement.title: My Articles
requirement.description: My Articles lists all of the author's articles (any status), most recently updated first, filterable by DRAFT / PUBLISHED / ARCHIVED.

req_spec.title: UC-S4-004 Notifications
req_spec.scope: In-app notifications with unread badge and user preferences. Source: UniShare_Iteration_4.md Use Case Diagram 4 + Use Case 4; src/server/api/routers/notification.ts; src/components/notification-bell.tsx; src/app/(student)/settings/page.tsx.

requirement.title: Event notifications
requirement.description: The system shall create a notification for the recipient when a course invitation is sent (COURSE_INVITATION), accepted (INVITATION_ACCEPTED) or declined (INVITATION_REJECTED).

requirement.title: Unread badge
requirement.description: The bell icon shows the number of unread notifications; no badge at 0; values above 9 show '9+'.

requirement.title: Recent notifications dropdown
requirement.description: Opening the bell lists the user's 20 most recent notifications, newest first; with none it shows 'No notifications yet'.

requirement.title: Mark one as read
requirement.description: Clicking a notification marks it read and decreases the badge by 1. A course/timetable invitation notification opens Settings > Pending Invitations (/settings?tab=invitations).

requirement.title: Mark all as read
requirement.description: 'Mark all as read' sets every unread notification of the user to read; badge disappears.

requirement.title: Notification privacy
requirement.description: A user can only list, count and mark his own notifications; another user's notification id gives 'Notification not found'.

requirement.title: Notification preferences
requirement.description: Settings > Notification Preferences lets the user switch in-app and email notifications on/off for Class reminders, Collaboration invites, Audit log alerts and System notifications. Defaults are created on first visit; saved values persist after reload.

requirement.title: Reminder timing range
requirement.description: Class reminder timing accepts 5 to 30 minutes before class; the UI offers 5, 10, 15 and 30.

requirement.title: Full notification history
requirement.description: 'View all' opens the full notification list, paginated (page size 1-100, default 20).
